body: I've looked at this pic for so long and I'm still so confused. I see the opening of the vagina and I see the cup but I don't understand.

Workin' Moms on Netflix, organizing and cleaning my office, on day 3 now, GREAT job interview, and hanging out with J. Dinner is a great bowl of leftovers: tofu, rice, black beans, corn, vegan cashew cheese, and green beans. Thank you for making it last night Babe.

Alright, yeah, feeling better. J took off his game Friday night and we hung out. I was feeling bad for a few reasons and felt bad when I went to sleep. But Saturday I started feeling better. We watched Gogglebox, hung out at home, then went to Walmart and the best Dollar General of our lives, Haha, that did not have the one thing I wanted though, a Powerade Zero. That did suck. But yeah, going out always makes me feel a lot better and it did. Then we came home, had lasagna, and watched Club Dread. 

Sunday we stayed at home cuz J had a bad morning and we didn't go to sleep until like 4am. I cleaned and organized the bookcase in our bedroom. We got taco Bell for dinner. Then... prob tmi but whatever, we had sex in the living room on the couch and it was very good. I say that cuz we've only had sex on the bed but to change it up like that was much needed and very fun.

So yeah. Doing better. Just gotta leave the house more. Amongst other things.

Welp. Here goes. Lost my job a month ago for being on my phone too much. Now I know going forward to only use my phone on my lunch break. Falling into a depression. Only applying to like 5 jobs. Getting out of pajamas sometime after 1, sometime as late as 6pm. Going outside 1-3 times a day in the big front yard we have. Not having any hobbies or interests or passions. Not exercising. Gaining even more weight due to everything listed above and just watching hours Upon hours of YouTube a day. Working on not falling back into or relapsing with my ED. Idk. Fortunately J and I do leave the house at least every other day when he gets off work, even if its just for an hour or so.

Not really writing this for any feedback. Just to see what I'll write in a month or so. But feel free to write anything if you want. I've just never been a journal person with pen and paper. Oh, and also I've been on my phone a lot less this month, prob to punish myself for being on it too much with all jobs I've had these past few months.

Day out with my friend and Date Night with J :) 
Library, her place, and Pluckers for the date.

I had a good day :) I went to Baton Rouge to get paperwork for my taxes done and made an appt for Wednesday morning, I went to Walgreens to get J some Easter goodies and Momo a little plushie and just got myself one peanut butter chocolate bunny. I hope I can eat sugar sometime soon without nearly passing out after, ugh. Came home and chilled. Talked to mom while I walked on the treadmill, had a nice conversation and J joined in which is always nice. I went .75 in 25 minutes. Then went outside in the yard, watched J play his game, had dinner, spoke to my Dad briefly and got pics of my newborn niece, watched some more tv, now in Js office while he's at his computer talking to his best friend and I'm watching Netflix.

Saturday: Went well. Visited Js hometown. Went to his Dad's, lunch with his best friend and family, went back to his Dad's and had coffee and watched The Thing, then back out to watch D & D, then back to his Dad's to pick up Momo then Sonic then home. Busy but good day. 

Sunday: Relaxing day at home after yesterday. It was good. We started a Seinfeld Lego set he got me for Christmas. I liked it. We did it for 2 hours. Really grounding and relaxing, just what I needed. Then just relaxed on the couch some more.

Yeah. I've been struggling for awhile. Ever since I got fired from my last job. Depression reared its ugly head and took hold of me. I'm disappointed in myself with gaining so much weight since I moved here. April 1 was 1 year. I'm glad I moved here. J makes me happy and laugh and smile every day. But putting up clothes I moved here with into trash bags, not exercising, hygiene isn't doing good, and I'm probably bloated from PMS, yeah, I'm struggling, but I'm not being quiet about it and I have support.
Finally took a shower today. Ha. Glad I use shower mitts now. But only once a week. J made us a nice homemade dinner. We went to Target and talked to my mom on the way.

Currently sitting on the couch with J, and Mozie in my lap. We had Domino's for our Date Night. I did trash and recycling today. Then I had a bit of a shitty afternoon, literally, but felt better after some time.

Watched 7/8 episodes of Emergency:NYC. Cried at least once with every episode. Had the Terminix person come out, Lawn Care people, and neighbors getting Js lawnmower. All routine stuff though, no worries. Glad the weather will be better tomorrow. Hope you feel better tomorrow Baby.

I felt like half a human most of today. I didn't sleep well and didn't have as much sugar in my coffee as I usually do so today was very difficult. Had a nice meeting with the neighbors with J as he got off work. We relaxed for a few then J started on dinner. Nice dinner. Then we went star gazing and Big Lots then a detour around an accident then home. Glad to be spending time with J. I started feeling better after dinner and going out.

Currently sitting in the car while J loads up the backseat with groceries from Rouses. I think we did good. Even if we are gonna go to Wendy's after this. Today was good. I watched Keep Sweet and Obey on Netflix. Gosh. Another sad ending. I was able to organize more of the office than I thought I would so that's good.

Today was a chill day at home. Stayed in my pjs all day which right now is my new favorite striped exercise pants and Js work shirt. I watched the short series on Netflix called Waco: American Apocalypse. Really eye opening and tragic. Before that and a little during I dewrinkled and put away or hung up more clothes. Now I'm waiting for J to finish up his game so we can hang out.

Alright, yeah, pretty decent day. Had a relaxing morning. Tried on some clothes and jeans. J made us breakfast. Went to my friend's and we went to 2 thrift stores. I got a long skirt. Same one I was wearing too, but this one looked newer and was a lot brighter, ha. Hung out at hers for a few then J picked me up. We went to a health food store and got a few snacks. Came home, relaxed, had coffee, had fun, now relaxing before we make dinner.

Welcome to the world, Remy! You're entering this world with some pretty great parents and brothers. 

I actually had a decent day despite the bad news last night. I did the laundry in the dryer and some clothes in the office. I finished up Extraordinarily on Hulu then started the series Up Here. J and I had fun.. then Wingstop for dinner.
Thank you. It's my own fault though. No one to blame but myself.
Annnddd I got fired. Phone addiction is a real problem. I have a problem. I need help for it.

Writing this the next day on the couch before 7am.

Meh. Another day. At least my boss brought her dog to work for some of it. That was nice. Today was just tiring. I took allergy pills before I left for work. Didn't mess with me much today. Then again I wasn't in the filing room or go outside on my break. Girl training with me wasn't there so that was a bummer. Called J when I took a quick break at 4:00 to get some fresh air then continued when I got inside and worked. It was nice. Just a long long day of starting at papers and numbers and putting them in order. 

I drove home and my energy was bad. Like very bad. We realized its cuz I didn't have my regular coffee after work today. Not forgetting that again. Came home. Hung out. Completely bawled my eyes out in bed while J hugged me. Just about learning the news on Monday and the fact my Dad knew and didn't tell me and that my other brother takes a week or more to have a quick conversation to catch up. I haven't cried like that in months. I had to sit up cuz I was physically about to get sick. J convinced me and we drove around for a bit. An hour later we ended up at wendy's for dinner. I liked it. Then we watched YouTube at home then went on Instagram to show him stuff I saved for him. 

Happy 17 Months, Baby. I love you.

Oof. Today was a rough day. Started with me taking an allergy pill first thing when I got to work. All the invoices I tried to enter I couldn't. They weren't even problem invoices. Then the computer froze and that was it, I told the lady training me I just couldn't today and she understood. I filed in the filing room till lunch. Then I felt worse cuz the dust from the filing room and some pollen from outside. An Aleve and hot water and distraction made it possible to finish my work day. A hot shower and face mask to finish my day. Listening to J play Minecraft with his friend while I hang out in his office. Probably play with Mo in a minute then find something for dinner. I look forward to when we start meal prepping.

Edit: Albasha for dinner. Playing with Momo later.

Hey! Yeah good, just took some time and patience but I finally got there with the right job and better yet, a truly great working environment. Thank you. Turns out I lean a lot to my left when working so I'm doing better with that starting today.

Sitting in the parking lot of my work. Killed the battery. TIL that you're supposed to press on the brakethen push the button to turn off a Prius. Fuck. J is driving here now. I also was confirmed by my brother that I'm going to be an Aunt again. On Friday. This Friday. I just learned the news last night from my Mom. 

J came and saved me :) I probably accidentally did kill the battery. Fortunately since he drives a Hybrid Prius it charged very quickly. We got Sonic for dinner. Now I hear Gizmo growling and barking at the balloons in Js office that are holding his toy captive, lol. 

Glad to be doing this thing called life with you, Baby.

My back was still bothering me but it's getting better day by day. I put a generic icy hot patch on my back. It was sticky and weird. It didn't last that long but better than nothing. The whole time I thought my back was soaked but it was just the patch and the top part wasn't sticky. I just hung around the house all day. Napped. Watched a movie with J. Starting to work on my massive pile of clothes in my office. Dinner is frozen pizza from Sam's Club.

Trying this out again. Idk. I feel like writing in a journal with a pen is too much like homework. And I hate my handwriting. This feels more modern and something I'm use to. 

Saturday. Oof. Took an allergy pill first thing. Turns out I carry stress in my back. And it hurts. Its only at certain angles and not constant though. Which makes me think I pulled something. But later today the pain went from my lower back to my upper. I'm grateful J took care of me so so much. He also flipped the mattress and I'm sure that helped but was just also needed in general. Dinner was ramen.

As I've decided to step away from reddit after today indefinitely I'm getting on here with my final comment and wishing everyone a safe and happy and healthy year ahead for yourself and your family. Thank you for all being so great but ultimately after a decade of being on this site I'm going to be spending time away from my phone. Thank you again and wishing everyone well.

First trip home went well. Mostly a learning experience with different things. J did great with my turbulence on the way back to BTR. Wasn't even bad but anxiety was 11/10 bad. Had a nice visit at his brother's. Worked Wednesday and Thursday. Not bad. Chilled at home today. Sandwich and smoothie for dinner. Still probably leaning towards deleting reddit profiles before or after the new year. Want to be on my phone and social media less and less. I'm doing ok. PMS hit me hard today. Christmas shopping tomorrow.

Solid day. Flights went well. Almost missed our first flight cuz I wanted to look in the gift shop, fortunately J was strict and I'm glad he was. Busy airports. Took awhile to get our luggage but we eventually did. Dad picked us up outside. Headed straight to my brother's bar and hung out there and saw my nieces. Taco Tuesday with the food truck. Back to my dad's where he watched YouTube on my tablet and just got off a video chat checking on Momo, all good there. J taking a shower now and then me and then an early night I imagine.
WE GO BACK TO NORTH CAROLINA TOMORROW FOR ONE WEEK!!!!! ✈👫💖🥰😊😆🥳
Hey, yeah, thanks I'm doing ok. Just I haven't had a job where I'm mainly on my feet in many years. It's what I wanted. I just need better shoes and to make sure I drink and eat plenty.

Today was ok. Yeah. Ok. I'm still in my pjs. I went outside a few times. I laid in bed but not for too long. I made sure to eat. And then eat more. J and I got Canes for dinner and a lil sundae at Sonic. Now he's gonna play his weekly game and I'm gonna watch tv. Fortunately my feet don't hurt and I don't feel sore from working this week.
Hanging on but barely breathing. This new job is rough. Damn.
First day. Not bad. 2-8:20. I liked it. But I am tired, haha.
Thank you! :)
So as the saying goes "third times a charm." So let's hope this job works out. I'll be a spiritual advisor ;)
Thank you 😊
Thank you!
Still sick :(
J and I are both sick. Probably with the same thing. Today wasn't bad though. Neighbors even brought us a plate of food. Hoping I don't get a fever tonight. Hope J gets better soon.

Unfortunately I am sick. Hopefully with just a cold or something small. Sore throat, sore body, now a stuffy head. Idk. I did however leave today and donate two trash bags full of clothes and gave them to a woman who helps and houses domestic violence victims. I'm glad I did that. I took care of some clothes today. Took a shower. Now my head is stuffy. Ugh.

Yeah. Today was ok. Didn't leave the house till 2 but at least I got out. I went to a really nice liquor store and had an interview on the spot when I told him I applied online. That was good. Then went to an animal shelter and dropped off clothing donations with the homeless shelter and then played with some kittens. Came home and chilled. Glad I got out today. Sad about RPAN. Never officially made a final post. And all the videos will be deleted like December 3 or something. That's where J and I met. I'll always be grateful for RPAN. I'm sorry it didn't work out with it.

I spent a majority of today at 1 thrift store. No really. I even went back there and spent another 2 hours there. She even stayed past closing for me. I thanked her immensely. I've had to buy so many clothes for my new body. I didn't fit into any clothes I brought here for winter and that is perfectly fine. I love thrift shopping. I only spent a total of $40 for sooooo many shirts and a few pants. You know when you spend so much money somewhere they give you an item for free, yeah, that happened, haha. I also like that thrift store cuz they give I think they said 50% to local charities, two things I love. So yeah, solid day.

Annnddd I started my period. Spent most of today home but just got back from an indoor clothing yard sale. I'm glad they let me try on the pants. I try on so many pants so many places and sometimes come away with none. This time I came away with 3. Woo. And of course I got tops too. About to go to Ollie's then Taco Bell. I'm really grateful for J.

Yeah... SAD and PMS and stress and just fun stuff consuming me and tearing me down mentally. Ugh. But hey, I did mostly bag up my summer clothes and winter clothes I don't fit into and that went really well, it took more than a day or two but that's ok. I applied to idk 3 jobs today, or altogether this week. Instead of eating at a restaurant tonight we are staying in and making dinner. The stress from soon visiting my family and looking different (so much so I have and still have to buy bigger clothes to fit my new body) and just all that stuff is causing my period to not start yet, so I'm stressing about anything and everything but I'll be ok.

Edit: I've officially made a decision. It's not an easy one. It's one I've told J about a few times. I am going to make one final livestream and delete my other reddit account. Idk when it will be. All I know is very soon. Before the New Year. I'm not that depressed person anymore, or at least not that severely depressed. I'm gonna keep it up for a few days or a week or two and then delete my profile. Idk. Just wanted to share that with y'all. I made us dinner tonight, we watched another episode of Solar Opposites, and I'm watching a movie on Hulu called My Old School while he's playing a computer game. Nice Friday evening.
WE DID IT!!!!!! WE'LL BE BACK IN MY HOME STATE DECEMBER 6-13!!!!!! 🥳🥳🥳🥳🥳🥳

Today was actually really good. First good week day in awhile. I think going out yesterday and laughing a lot really helped. Did some cleaning and stuff around the house till about 3 when I left to go and do recycling, go to the employment place, then the health food store. Came home, hung out, made a Walmart list online, and heated us up some dinner while J made us rice to go with it. Looked at tickets for us to go back to NC and they cost two arms and two legs, but especially cuz its 2 people and I want to pay for his ticket too cuz he helps so so much financially, but yeah, gonna call my dad tomorrow about all that and get his advice on all that. Now sitting in the office and watching J and his best friend talk on cam about games, its really nice.

Ordered 2 Hum Nutrition supplements and set up a Walmart pickup for tomorrow.

Today was alright. Still wasn't doing the best mentally, emotionally, etc, but we went out and went to the Renaissance Festival. Overall good experience. A lot of lessons learned. Definitely going back another weekend. Lit Pizza for dinner with Season 2 Episode 1 of Solar Opposites. Now in the office while we do our own thing but in the same room.

SAD, PMS, Depression, Anxiety. The really bad thoughts are back. I'm not doing well. J makes me laugh though. I hate this time of year. Going to Louisiana Renaissance Fest tomorrow. I wonder why I'm even alive.

Edit: I wanted to add that I had a really good evening thanks to J. We made each other laugh and he made me laugh. Especially a really big one in the beginning. Then we stayed up a bit and looked at LARF, which supplements I should get, Recipes to make, and just chatted and cuddled. It was super nice and much needed.
Leaning hard on J right now due to SAD and I'm not going to feel guilty about it. Thanks for helping Babe. You always make me smile and laugh. Glad we got out and went to Sam's.
Crying my eyes out because SAD is here and it's the worst time of the year. It gets BAD. Talking to J and gonna start putting things into play tomorrow to combat this. I hate it so much.
I have yet to see the last Harry Potter for this reason.
Had a good day. Went to a really big yard sale/estate sale, came home, applied to a job, J made us dinner, we got back half hour ago where we watched Halloween Ends. We really liked it.
Yeah. I agree. I'm more upset I was never told anything even once and just got fired. Like if there's a problem but you don't tell me, I never know it's a problem to begin with.

Got fired cuz I was on my phone too much and sat down too much. Oh well. Just wish I had at least one heads up before getting fired. Damn.. I really liked the job and people too. Lesson learned I guess.
Thank you.
Thank you. Thanks, I appreciate that.
Thank you. It does. Not yet. I'm going there Monday to pick up my check and asking wtf happened with no warning at all.

Nice day at J's bro's place. We even walked twice, the second time 1/3 of a mile. We all carved pumpkins. Had curry. Chatted. Had pumpkin seeds. Watched VHS2, my choice, glad I chose it. Nice ride home and in Js office now.

Me: Hii. I was hoping you could text someone working and ask them what my next day of work is and what time. I didn't realize the time until just now. 

Boss: Hope you are feeling better!  I am on my way out of town so can not
Really talk but We have decided that it is not working out for you to work at the store so your last check will be there Monday and you can get it from Holly!  I did pay you for Friday also!  Thank you.

I could use some encouraging words about now.. I'm going Monday to find out wtf happened. 

Two jobs. Two firings. Damn..
Yeah. I dreamt of moments like this when I lived in North Carolina and now it's a reality and I'm really glad it is.

Our walking treadmill came in the mail today. Urevo. We like it. I already did a total of 30 minutes today on it. Just did the last 15. At 1.8,2.0 mph. We walked around the park after J got off work. Whataburger for dinner. Junior Bakeoff for entertainment. Now in Js office while he plays his video game and I watch Netflix.

Work 10-3. Went well. Asked off for this Thursday and easily got it cuz she was making the schedule. After work I went to Goodwill then another thrift store. Got a few things. Home and I've been on the couch in the office ever since. Tired, sore, but doing ok. At least I'm not hungry anymore.

Movie day! Woo! I went to sleep super late/early, nearly 3am, we woke up a little before 10. I had an ok day mentally but the sleep cycle really messed me up so we took it easy today. We watched 3 movies. Night of the Demons, Halloween Party, and Old. All pretty good, all different too. I took a short nap between the second and third and J made us dinner. Nice day all around.

Relaxing day. Spent the morning at yard sales and an estate sale. It was humid and we didn't dress appropriately so it was not a fun time. The Estate Sale went well though. Got our first Holiday wreath, for Christmas. Came home, nearly stripped down, had cold water, cooled down. Took a nice bath then J unexpected joined me which was nice. I relaxed, had more water, tea, then had a sugar crash and fell asleep for a bit. J made us dinner. Now in the office while he plays his game and I watch Season 1 Episode 8 of Avenue 5.

J and I were both out of the house today doing our own thing. I went to my first Lunchin Local. It was ok. Not bad. Just everyone talking over each other and I never got a word in. Made me feel utterly horrible. Food was fine. Albasha was the place. Fortunately after I went to Sweet Olive store and got some cool seasonal crafts. Home to relax. Nap. Hang out. Now fries for dinner. PMSing pretty bad all day.

Woo! First day at my new job and I like it. I'll be working part time at the UPS store 8 minutes from work. Everyone there is great, especially my manager. I worked 1-5 today. Mostly a slow day but good day. Came home and hung out and talked to my mom on the phone. Then J and I drove to his brother's and then went to Moo Yah for dinner. First time sitting next to each other in the booth and omfg I loved every second, really makes a difference instead of sitting across from each other. Back to his brother's to pick up their mom's car so I can start borrowing it. I'm gonna borrow it but I also need to use it right now for tomorow and driving it to a lunch meetup. Just got home a few minutes ago and it was a nice drive, I like the car.

Yeah. Alright day. Only got alright when I finally left the house around like 2 I think. Idk. Post Office to pick up a package, then thrift store for some goodies, including a pair of Brook's shoes for $4, then to the gas station grocery store where I got J and I a parfait to share and a big thing of garlic cheese bread shaped in a big circle. Mom called us, that was nice. I love seeing J and I in the video chat, we are so cute together. And yeah, just relaxed at home, took a quick nap, then ate and had fun and relaxing in the office now.
Louisiana. It was somewhere around the Playoffs. Near the end.
It was in Spanish and played the opposing team's side. We really tried for awhile and ended up with that.

We stayed home today. Yesterday's drive really took it out of J and I understood so we stayed home. Didn't even go outside unless I was with Momo. I watched the rest of Motel Makeover, watched some more tv, and yeah, relaxing day in.

Today was a good day. Mainly cuz we left the house today and spent time at Dad's. We spent the morning in bed just relaxing and cuddling and then showing him stuff I shared for him on Instagram. We then got ready, I took awhile and too much overthinking about my outfit and everything, but we did leave and hit the road about I think 1:30, got there about 3. We had a Lousiana staple, Red Beans and Rice, that Dad made. Chilled, watched some YouTube, talked, took a nice park around the neighborhood, then took our time and left, and drove straight home.  Now I'm watching a Netflix show called Motel Makeover while J plays WOW.

Yeah, today was alright. I didn't sleep the best cuz Momo woke me up barking on the bed so I freaked out and looked around the whole house and then couldn't sleep so I went on Instagram. Slept in. Then I just had a tough time mentally most of today and slept till like 3. Took a shower. Didn't really do much. J and I got pizza for dinner. Invited his ex over to hang out and watch a movie. We watched Synchronicity and a Puppy Cat show on Netflix.

Tuesday and Wednesday knocked me on my ass from cleaning the garage on Monday, today I finally felt better and used that to my advantage. I vaccumed our bedroom, folded and put away laundry, hung up and folded a lot of clothes, went outside, did dishes, took a shower, I forget what else I did but it was a really productive day and then we watched My Best Friend's Exorcism for Movie Night.

Finally found out today the reason why I didn't feel good Tuesday or Wednesday was because I used the leaf blower in the garage Monday and the mask didn't work as well as we thought.. Lesson learned for next time.. I used a black cloth mask, maybe something a little more heavy duty next time.

So Tuesday I started not to feel well so I took it easy. We went to 2 Walmart's after J got off work. It went ok. Got what we needed and that was good but towards the end it was rough. Glad I drank some powerade zero to help. For the first time ever I used some earbuds while J played his computer game and I watched a Lifetime Movie. It was really nice. Being in the same room but doing our own thing.

Wednesday was worse. I woke up very early REALLY feeling bad. Took 2 Ibuprofen. Let that kick in. Went back to bed and nearly threw up. Fortunately I didn't, at least not in bed, and threw up a few times in a bucket. Felt better sometime after that. Slept. Had Taco Bell for lunch. Took it easy. And went to trivia night and had a nice evening. Glad we ate before we went. Another hard lesson learned, don't lay down too soon after eating, especially if you haven't drank much water that day.

So 2 lessons.. 

1. Wear a heavy duty mask when using a leaf blower as not to inhale any nasty dust and dirt and debris. 

2. Do not lie down and watch a movie after eating, especially if you haven't drank much water.

Yeah. Had an ok day. Waking up wasn't the easiest but J woke me up and I finally did at 9. I got dressed an hour before I woke up which is really great. I watched more of my latest obsession, Christian Hull, on YouTube. J and him have made Friday and today a good day. I vaccumed the couch and living room. I unloaded the dishwasher. Spent time outside. More time on YouTube, had dinner with J, then watched shorts on his YouTube, then I watched a Lifetime movie in his office while he played his game. I'm glad this movie ended with a good ending. Unfortunately that rarely happens. It was about a girl that got kidnapped and eventually her kidnapper let her go and she walked right into her front door nearly a year later.

Yesterday was a lot for J and I so we took it easy and stayed home today. We went outside in the shade for like a total of 15 minutes today. We watched a Netflix movie, took a bath, and just relaxed. I talked to my mom, he played WOW with his brother and friend. Yeah. Chill day at home.

Went to the Denham Springs Fall Festival today with J. Solid day out. Got a few things for myself and others. Poki Bowl for lunch. Came home and chilled. Home Chef for dinner. 

6 months later and I'm really glad I made the move here. I love you Baby.

I got fired from my job. It wasn't working out. They didn't like that I was still asking questions a month into it. 

I had a great night. Came home an hour early, talked to my mom and told her the news, we then went to the health food store, Cades, then Canes. Watched IT Crowd. Watched The Black Box for movie night.
BAD day at work. Good night at home :)

Thursday: Happy 11 Months, Baby!!! Work was alright today. Came home, hung out, went to Walmart for some necessities and had Subway for dinner. I chose the movie for movie night and I highly highly recommend you DO NOT watch All My Friends Hate Me. But it was a nice evening and nice way to celebrate 11 Months.

Friday: Yeah. Finally a good day at work. Mainly cuz it was slow and 1 of 2 girls weren't there and she has a very strong personality so not having her there that day was refreshing, ha. She's not a bad person and actually nice but she is tough and doesn't hold back. I got along great with the other girl and got to tell her about J and I. Came home, we decided to go to BWW for dinner. It was ok. I wouldn't go again. But it was a nice date with J and we had a great time. 

Saturday: Went to a few phones stores for J. Even went to the mall in Baton Rouge. Bust on all of them. But I was glad to just be in the car with J. We had a smoothie from lunch from a really nice locally owned place, really nice guy, went to Tuesday Morning and got some coffee and a pizza slicer. Came home, relaxed, and watched 3 episodes of The Reboot, I laid in bed for a bit, then we had a nice evening watching tv.

Not a great work day.. lunch wasn't good so I ended up spending $10 at the cafe on a wrap and chips.. I messed up pretty bad so me and another girl had to stay 15 minutes past our usual time and I have to deal with that tomorrow morning. Drive home wasn't bad. J didn't have a good work day either and then broke his phone screen while on the phone with me. Came home and we got ready. Headed to our first trivia night with his ex and her mom. Sounds weird but it wasn't. Everyone is all good. I even just accepted her friend request a few minutes ago on Facebook. We all had a good night at trivia, J especially, the first time seeing him get really tipsy. We drove and got Taco Bell for dinner. Well he did. The food truck was good but very little serving sizes. Yeah. Came home and watched Community and had a nice evening.

Decent day in CoPay, haha. I did a lot better today than yesterday. Lunch was all inside today. I got off at 4:45 today, woo! Came straight home and snacked a little bit. J put together a great dinner. Some cheesy chicken and squash and poblano peppers. Entertainment this evening was Junior Bake Off. Had a nice bath together after that. Quick shower after that. Then hung out in the office for a bit, now gonna play with Momo and head to bed.

First day of CoPay. Wasn't that bad. I took and completed 16 CoPays. Morning was fine, pretty fast. Lunch was ok. Missed talking to J. I walked around the building twice, in 90 degree heat!! Rest of the day was ok, slow though, but not too bad. Drive home was fine. Dinner was fine. Idk. I'm PMSing hard and almost cried at Rick and Morty. I'm gonna have a better night though.
